scope: All14 actual rendered introductions read; deterministic equality proves remaining article text unchanged after the separately reviewed update-date change. Six content ratings are retained, never raised.

rows.reviewedIntroduction: Separate discovery, indexing, search relevance and Maps eligibility when a small business website is missing from Google. Includes a practical evidence worksheet.
rows.renderedIntroduction: Record the missing page and search. Check Google indexing and relevance, with clear next steps for you and your web person.
rows.assessment: The opening names the missing page/search and indexing/relevance checks, matching the diagnostic article without promising ranking.

rows.reviewedIntroduction: Find where a website inquiry stops: submission, saved receipt, email notification, inbox or reply. A business-owner checklist with a clearly labeled test worksheet.
rows.renderedIntroduction: Check your form, notification settings and inbox. Follow a missing inquiry from submission to reply, with optional technical checks and a scoped repair request.
rows.assessment: The submission-to-reply sequence preserves the full inquiry path and distinguishes optional technical checks from a scoped repair.

rows.reviewedIntroduction: Decide when a service-area page helps customers, what local facts belong on it and when one county coverage page is enough. Includes a planning worksheet.
rows.renderedIntroduction: Decide which locations need their own page. Use real service coverage, customer questions and facts, with a simple planning worksheet.
rows.assessment: The opening asks whether separate locations deserve pages and retains real coverage and factual inputs.

rows.reviewedIntroduction: A practical website maintenance schedule for forms, content, accounts, recovery and supported updates, with a downloadable work log and clear ownership.
rows.renderedIntroduction: Check forms, pages, certificates and website responsibilities. Separate the checks you can make from work for your web person.
rows.assessment: Forms, pages, certificates and responsibilities match the maintenance checks; owner versus specialist work remains clear.

rows.reviewedIntroduction: Plan contractor website content around accepted jobs, project evidence, service areas and estimate requests. Includes a content and inquiry worksheet for a real project brief.
rows.renderedIntroduction: Plan clear services, accepted jobs, project examples, service areas and estimate requests for your contractor website.
rows.assessment: Accepted jobs, real project examples, territory and estimate requests match the contractor checklist.

rows.reviewedIntroduction: Plan a small business website or redesign budget with current studio prices, ongoing costs, migration work and a practical quote checklist. Based in Buffalo; serving 50 states, Washington, DC, and Puerto Rico.
rows.renderedIntroduction: Plan build fees, hosting, domains and optional monthly work. Compare package scope and use the worksheet to budget with clear assumptions.
rows.assessment: Build and recurring provider costs are separated, with package scope and assumptions rather than a universal price promise.

rows.reviewedIntroduction: Prepare a redesign brief for your service business, with a download covering pages, facts, account ownership and launch checks.
rows.renderedIntroduction: Gather your business facts, customer tasks, pages, content and decision makers before asking for a website redesign proposal.
rows.assessment: Business facts, tasks, pages, content and decision makers match the redesign-brief preparation.

rows.reviewedIntroduction: Local SEO and Google Business Profile eligibility for small service businesses: online-only work, service areas, address choices and useful website content.
rows.renderedIntroduction: Check Google Business Profile eligibility, real customer contact and service areas before making a local-search plan.
rows.assessment: Eligibility and actual customer contact precede local-search planning; no automatic eligibility is claimed.

rows.reviewedIntroduction: See how search research becomes a finished page improvement, what the monthly plans include and how to read the report.
rows.renderedIntroduction: See how research leads to a completed improvement and a monthly report. Separate the work delivered from rankings, clicks and business results.
rows.assessment: Delivered work is explicitly separated from rankings, clicks and business outcomes.

rows.reviewedIntroduction: Plan a website migration with an old-to-new URL map, redirects, form checks, account ownership and a measured launch review. Includes a CSV worksheet.
rows.renderedIntroduction: Map old pages to their new destinations, check redirects and test contact forms. Includes an example and a website-migration worksheet.
rows.assessment: URL mapping, redirects, forms and the worked worksheet match the migration article.

rows.reviewedIntroduction: Compare a custom website and a template around content, editing, accessibility, ongoing cost and the customer journey for a small service business.
rows.renderedIntroduction: Compare design, content, editing, ongoing costs and handoff. Choose the approach that fits the work your business website needs to do.
rows.assessment: Design, content, editing, cost and handoff are the actual decision dimensions; no claim of universal superiority.

rows.reviewedIntroduction: Compare routine checks and small edits with work to improve a service page. Includes plan prices and a worksheet for choosing the job you need.
rows.renderedIntroduction: Compare website checks and changes you send with researched improvements. See which problem each plan solves and choose a useful next step.
rows.assessment: Owner-supplied changes and researched improvements preserve the care-versus-SEO distinction.

rows.reviewedIntroduction: Start with a customer task that fails, use the checklist and see two small fixes made to this website.
rows.renderedIntroduction: Start with a failing customer task. Use the checklist, inspect two documented studio fixes and record what still needs checking.
rows.assessment: The failing task, documented studio examples and remaining checks match the bounded evidence in the audit guide.

rows.reviewedIntroduction: For small service businesses deciding whether an existing website needs a small fix, broader changes or a rebuild. Includes practical examples and a decision worksheet.
rows.renderedIntroduction: Choose a small repair, broader rework or rebuild. Compare examples and use the worksheet to find the smallest change that solves the problem.
rows.assessment: Repair, rework and rebuild remain distinct; the worksheet supports the smallest effective scope rather than an assumed rebuild.
